title: Wounded officer still in hospital; Gunman shot dead by second officer after police respond to disturbance on Dufferin St.: [York Guardian Edition]
article: A Toronto police sergeant with 13 Division continues to recover in hospital after being shot in the arm Saturday evening.
The gunman was shot dead by another officer.

Police said officers responding to a call for threatening behaviour at the Shiatsu Therapy Clinic on Dufferin Street just north of Rogers Road were confronted by a man armed with a shotgun around 6:15 p.m. The man shot Sgt. Allan Jenkins, an 18-year veteran of the service. Another officer returned fire, killing the gunman, police said.
Jenkins and 63-year-old Antonio Bellon were rushed to Sunnybrook and Women's College Health Sciences Centre where Bellon was pronounced dead.
An autopsy performed Sunday determined Bellon died from a single gunshot wound to the chest.
The province's Special Investigations Unit and the Toronto Police homicide squad are probing the shooting.
The name of the officer who shot the gunman is not being released.
"We've conducted 12 interviews with police and civilian witnesses," SIU spokesperson Rose Hong told The Guardian yesterday. "We've designated a subject officer and two witness officers."
Jenkins is one of the two witness officers.
The subject officer is the one whose conduct appears to have caused the death under investigation, the SIU said noting a subject officer is not a suspect.
The SIU, a civilian agency that investigates whenever there is a serous injury or death involving police, has assigned a team of investigators and forensic identification technicians to the case.
"We need to conduct an extensive review and we will take the time we need," Hong said. "The investigation is continuing."
The SIU investigators will review witness interviews, review physical evidence and validate information.
Police closed Dufferin Street north of Rogers Road for numerous hours late Saturday and early Sunday for the investigation.
"The scene has been processed and documented," Hong said. Investigators also conducted a canvass of the area Sunday.
